questions.q: What type of scanner is the Honeywell Orbit (MS7120 / 7190g)?
questions.e: The Orbit is a hands-free presentation scanner for fixed-position checkouts; the 7190g is the modern 1D/2D hybrid.

questions.q: A customer needs to read barcodes off customers' phone screens. Which Honeywell scanner is NOT suitable?
questions.e: The 1200g is a 1D single-line laser and reads printed codes only. Phone screens need a 2D area imager.

questions.q: Which Honeywell family is the ultra-rugged, IP65 industrial scanner for warehouse and manufacturing?
questions.e: Granit (e.g. 1990i/1991i) is IP65-sealed, drop-rated and reads damaged/dirty labels; the XR variant adds extended range.
